Church Family Tree Conversation with One Build a Table
This map traces the movements, revivals, and divisions of Christian history as rivers that wind and widen across time. Click any name, river, or icon to read its documented story: who carried it, its legacy, and where the record comes from. A growing number of Christian traditions are fully built, each with its own representative voice you can have a conversation with. The thin lines crossing between worlds mark real, documented relationships. Drag to pan, scroll or pinch to zoom, hover a name for a glimpse, click for the full story.
